sentences.text: Pterygornis is an extinct genus of avialan belonging to the clade Enantiornithes that inhabited China during the Lower Cretaceous.
The name Pterygornis combines the Latin word for wing and the Ancient Greek word for bird.
Pterygornis is a monotypic genus, with only the type species P. dapingfangensis named.
The genus Pterygornis was described by Wang and colleagues in 2016.
The species name dapingfangensis refers to the town of Dapingfang where the fossils were discovered.
Pterygornis is classified within the subclass Enantiornithes.
Pterygornis lived in East Asia during the Aptian stage of the Early Cretaceous epoch.
Pterygornis lived between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago during the Aptian stage.
